description: This script encodes firmware files for MOXA IW devices by adding headers, encrypting data, and handling firmware partitioning. It provides command-line functionality to process firmware images.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Data class representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: bytes xor(data: bytes)
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption/decryption on input bytes using a specific passphrase.

methods.name: bytes add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
methods.description: Adds a firmware header containing metadata, offsets, and a CRC to the firmware data.

methods.name: bytes add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int)
methods.description: Prepends a file-specific header with filename, size, and CRC to data.

methods.name: int crc(data: bytes, init_val: int)
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with specific initial value and XOR transformation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function orchestrating firmware segmentation, header addition, encryption, and file writing.

ctags.name: add_file_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: add_fw_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int,$/
ctags.signature: (data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
